overview_description.description: Eisen is a compliance operations platform that helps financial institutions manage escheatment, disbursement, and regulatory reporting processes for dormant or inactive accounts. The company provides tools that automate workflows related to unclaimed property compliance, including customer outreach, stale check management, failed payouts, and account offboarding. Its platform integrates with existing financial systems to help organizations monitor dormancy risk, track state reporting deadlines, and manage fund disbursements across different account types. Eisen also offers solutions tailored for industries such as banking, credit unions, insurance, telecommunications, retirement plan administration, and cryptocurrency platforms. In addition to software tools, the company supports operational compliance activities by helping businesses manage regulatory obligations tied to inactive assets and unclaimed property laws.

about_short_description.short_description: Eisen is a compliance operations platform that helps financial institutions manage escheatment, disbursement, and 1099 reporting.

product.name: Escheatment Manager
product.description: Automates the escheatment process for financial institutions, ensuring compliance with state-specific unclaimed property laws by tracking dormant accounts, managing due diligence, and filing reports.

product.name: Outreach Hub
product.description: Automates customer outreach for escheatment compliance by generating and sending state-mandated notices to account holders before accounts become unclaimed.

product.name: Disbursement Hub
product.description: Manages the secure disbursement of payments to customers, including refunds and final account payouts, while ensuring compliance with escheatment regulations.

product.name: Dormant Account Management
product.description: Identifies and manages dormant accounts by tracking inactivity, automating outreach, and ensuring compliance with escheatment laws.

product.name: Stale Check Processing
product.description: Tracks and manages uncashed or stale checks to resolve liabilities and ensure compliance with escheatment requirements.

product.name: Wind Down Management
product.description: Automates the process of closing multiple accounts, managing customer outreach, disbursements, and escheatment compliance during large-scale account closures.
